topThree.name: Booking Lifecycle Transactional Email
topThree.journey: Confirmed booking or member cancellation → accurate business-owned message → existing Resend delivery → member/staff delivery status
scope: Booking confirmation and member cancellation email using authoritative committed outcomes
Reusable business-scoped templates, sender configuration and validated recipient rules
Reuse existing events, jobs, audit and recovery contracts; deduplicate retries without changing booking state
Show pending, sent, delivered, bounced or failed only when supported by evidence; ambiguous provider outcomes require reconciliation
reviewDecisions: Recipient authority and purpose-specific preference/suppression rules
Sender/reply-to identity per business and approved message content
Bounded Development recipient list and explicit provider-execution approval
topThree.why: Closes the immediate gap after a successful booking, proves the smallest useful communications journey, and establishes delivery handling reusable by later dragons.

topThree.name: Class Changes & Waitlist Updates
topThree.journey: Staff changes or cancels an occurrence, or promotes a waitlist entry → affected member receives accurate update
scope: Reuse existing occurrence and promotion records and in-app notices
Notify only affected business-owned participants with change details and next action
Preserve staff promotion, cancellation and credit rules; delivery must never change those outcomes
Deduplicate overlapping changes and retain event-specific delivery evidence

topThree.name: Class Reminders & Communication Preferences
topThree.journey: Upcoming valid booking → eligible reminder at the approved time → member manages communication preferences
scope: Business-timezone-aware reminders from current booking records
Recheck cancellation, rescheduling and recipient eligibility before sending
Reuse existing preferences while making message purposes explicit
Prevent stale or duplicate reminders and expose understandable staff delivery history
reviewDecisions: Reminder timing, quiet hours and eligible channels
Required service messages versus optional studio updates; do not infer marketing consent

providerBoundary: Reuse approved Resend; no provider evaluation, credential permission expansion or delivery activation in this review.
